items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: so he put me on a little miniature piano and had Jack on a big Steinway.

ctx.x: in Philadelphia. Andy decided to use me for that theatre date, so he put me on a little miniature piano and had Jack on a big Steinway. So I was on the left of it, a left-handed stage, and he was over to the right. One afternoon Jack got sick or something happened to him. Steeple used to bring people in - he said, "Call the kid." He had the people sitting in the theatre just listening to me play and all that but they wouldn't do anything about Jack. So this particular time when Jack got sick, or whatever happened…
